verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers RevenueCat's entitlements, SDKs, customer info, webhooks, dashboards, and AI tools, but contains no mention of proration logic, credit calculations, partial-period billing, or invoice-level reconciliation math — RevenueCat largely defers billing mechanics to Apple/Google/Stripe and documents none of this itself in the pack. Since subscription-management platforms are a fair category to expect documented proration/credit math, the axis applies, but no evidence supports it.
